report.explanation: Current gateway telemetry is healthy: traces OK at 65ms, error_rate 0.0012, p95 76ms, INFO 200 logs, zero dependency timeouts and pool waiters. This contradicts the alert and supports no bounded root-cause candidate. Downstream services are unobserved. Handing off for evidence of an actual breach and downstream telemetry.
missing_evidence: Gateway metrics show error_rate 0.0012 and p95 76ms, contradicting the alert; need telemetry confirming an actual error-rate/latency breach and its time window.
No downstream service telemetry (order, payment, inventory, postgresql, redis) to test downstream-latency, db-pool-exhaustion, or redis-timeout candidates.
No error-level logs or failing spans; need evidence of errors/timeouts to substantiate any cause.
No deployment or configuration records to evaluate bad-configuration.
No memory-retention time series to evaluate memory-leak.
